text:
Predicates:
FinancialAid(x, y) ::: x provides financial aid to y.
Applicants(x) ::: x is an applicant.
EconomicHardship(x) ::: x has economic hardship.
Difficulty(x) ::: x is caused by having too little money or resources.
LivesInFamily(x, y) ::: x lives in family y.
SingleParentFamily(y) ::: y is a single-parent family.
HasBeenOutOfWorkForMoreThanAYear(x) ::: x has been out of work for more than a year.
Premises:
Cost(GRE, US$205) ::: It costs US $205 to take the GRE test.
FinancialAid(ETS, y) ∧ Applicants(y) ∧ EconomicHardship(y) ::: ETS provides financial aid to applicants who prove economic hardship.
EconomicHardship(x) ↔ Difficulty(x) ::: Economic hardship refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or resources.
LivesInFamily(tom, family) ∧ SingleParentFamily(family) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
HasBeenOutOfWorkForMoreThanAYear(dad) ::: His dad has been out of work for more than a year.
Conclusion:
FinancialAid(ETS, tom) ::: Tom can apply for financial aid from ETS to take the GRE test.
